name: brand-member-invitation-flow
title: Add verified business-owner and Brand member invitation flow
description: Require email verification for new business owners, support verified Brand invitations, and revoke Brand access without changing the separate employee-creation workflow.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Employee/staff account creation remains out of scope. Brand access revocation is a soft membership revoke with audit metadata and invitation-token invalidation. The global User role and userType are not automatically demoted. Cancelled invitations can be sent again with a fresh token. Focused backend tests, GraphQL checks, BrandManagement component tests, and the frontend production build passed in GitHub Actions run 28920292784. The repository-wide backend CI remains subject to the existing mongoose-lean-virtuals package/lock mismatch and unrelated full-suite failures.
